name: Secure
why: A repo's security, from keys no session reads to alerts closed within a week
ideal: No session reads a key, scans run in minutes, the threat model stays current, reports have a private path, and alerts close within a week.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: Quickstart for securing your repository
GitHub Docs: Adding a security policy to your repository

steps.name: Keys
steps.rule: Deny rules keep key files out of a session's reach.

steps.name: Scan
steps.rule: A scan runs on every push and finishes in minutes.

steps.name: Model
steps.rule: The threat model is reviewed whenever the attack surface changes.

steps.name: Report
steps.rule: A security policy gives reporters a private path.

steps.name: Alerts
steps.rule: An open alert closes within a week.
